block_05_direct_answer.title: Direct answer
block_05_direct_answer.body_html: A good entry price is one that is defensible against comparable alternatives and the asset’s risks. For an Abu Dhabi purchase, compare location, property type, unit quality, payment timing, total purchase costs and the trade-offs attached to the advertised price. Protect the overall buying case rather than stretching to a headline price, discount or low initial payment.

items.answer: Hidden costs are usually the expenses omitted from the headline property price. Major transaction or ownership costs have not been included in the affordability calculation. Use transaction-specific figures because the mix and amount of costs can differ materially between properties.
